text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The ruling MPLA's information secretary Joao Lourenco said he is confident that a government of national unity will be formed at the end of March and that the remaining UNITA deputies will return to the capital from UNITA's stronghold Bailundo.
- The Spanish government announced a $110 million line of credit for the agricultural, transport and health sectors, director of Spanish Cooperation said.

- The National Assembly approved a temporary resolution that authorises that government to pay public service salaries on a monthly basis ahead of approving the budget in full. The move was taken to avert a strike threat on March 20.
